1. (Currently amended) A packaging substrate comprising: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having a plurality of conductive paths formed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the conductive paths configured to provide electrical connection between an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure, wherein the opening is formed through a solder mask layer disposed on the packaging structure; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to at least one of a bottom surface or a sidewall of the opening, and wherein the stiffening microstructure has a dimension in the micrometer range.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface and is configured to provide thermal management between an integrated circuit chip and a lid structure.

5. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the chip mounting surface is on a solder mask layer, and the opening extends through the solder mask layer, and wherein the packaging structure further comprises a core layer disposed below the solder mask layer, the opening exposing a portion of the core layer.

6. (Cancelled)

7. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising: an integrated circuit chip mounted on the chip mounting surface, wherein the stiffening microstructure includes a lid structure in contact with the integrated circuit chip.

8. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 7, wherein the stiffening microstructure includes a lid.

9. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 8 further comprising: a heat transfer medium providing a thermally conductive pathway between the lid and the integrated circuit chip, wherein the heat transfer medium is disposed between the lid and the integrated circuit chip in a manner that enhances thermal dissipation.

10. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is a ring.

11. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a ground reference plane layer disposed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface of the packaging structure, wherein the ground reference plane layer is in contact with the stiffening microstructure, and wherein the stiffening microstructure is electrically isolated from the ground reference plane layer by a dielectric material.

12. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising a dielectric bonding agent coupling the stiffening microstructure to the packaging structure.

13. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising a conductive bonding agent coupling the stiffening microstructure to the packaging structure.

14. (Currently amended) A computing device, comprising: a memory; and a packaged semiconductor device communicatively coupled to the memory, wherein the packaged semiconductor device comprises: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure, wherein the opening is formed through a solder mask layer disposed on the packaging structure; an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and communicatively coupled to the memory through the packaging structure; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, wherein the stiffening microstructure has a dimension in the micrometer range and is bonded to at least one of a bottom surface or a sidewall of the opening.

15. (Cancelled)

16. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface and is configured to provide thermal management between the integrated circuit chip and a lid structure.

17. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the chip mounting surface is on a solder mask layer, and the opening extends through the solder mask layer, and wherein the packaging structure further comprises a core layer disposed below the solder mask layer, the opening exposing a portion of the core layer.

18. (Cancelled)

19. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure includes one of a ring or a lid, wherein the lid is in contact with the integrated circuit chip.

20. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a ground reference plane layer disposed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface of the packaging structure, wherein the stiffening microstructure is in contact with the ground reference plane layer, and wherein the stiffening microstructure is electrically isolated from the ground reference plane layer by a dielectric material.
